name: Paper and blueprint
note: White paper, near-black type and one blue reserved for links and the primary action. Suits software pages that need to read as precise rather than decorative.
avoid: No tinted panels, no secondary blues, no gradient washes.

name: Frost and slate
note: A cool, quiet ground with a deep teal accent. Reads as calm infrastructure and keeps technical screens from turning blue-violet.
avoid: Do not add a second cool accent or glass panels.

name: Linen and olive
note: Warm linen with olive, the colour of produce and outdoor tables. Built for places where the photograph carries the emotion and the interface stays quiet.
avoid: No black chrome, no neon, no glossy cards.

name: Terracotta and clay
note: Sun-warmed clay and a rust accent for food, craft and rooms. The palette assumes real photography rather than illustration.
avoid: No pink, no coral gradients, no drop shadows on photographs.

name: Sand and ink
note: A sandy ground with a deep green accent. Works for guesthouses, clinics and studios that want warmth without nostalgia.
avoid: No sepia filters or faux paper textures.

name: Chalk and cobalt
note: Chalk-white page, near-black type and a cobalt action. A hard-working developer-tool palette that keeps code and product UI legible.
avoid: No violet, no dark mode inversion, no glowing borders.

name: Shell and forest
note: Cool shell green with a forest accent, suited to professional services that want steadiness rather than corporate blue.
avoid: No leaf illustrations as decoration, no eco clichés.

name: Porcelain and crimson
note: Porcelain white with a single crimson mark. Strong for legal, editorial and retail pages that need one confident gesture.
avoid: No red-on-red sections, no alarm-state styling for ordinary links.

name: Oat and ink
note: An almost monochrome palette where ink itself is the accent. Lets typography and photography carry the page.
avoid: No colour accent at all; do not add one late.

name: Ice and copper
note: Cold aluminium surfaces with a copper action. Built for hardware where macro photography supplies the warmth.
avoid: No chrome gradients, no glowing edges, no sci-fi blue.

name: Light sage
note: Sage-tinted neutrals with a dark green accent for care, wellness and advisory work. Quiet enough to let faces and rooms lead.
avoid: No pastel mint, no rounded blob backgrounds.

name: Clean carmine
note: A clean retail ground with a carmine accent for price, cart and one band. Keeps product photography dominant.
avoid: No discount-red everywhere, no badge clutter.

name: Graphite and lime
note: Near-black graphite with a lime signal colour. For game pages that need energy without neon violet or a cyberpunk cliché.
avoid: No purple, no scanlines, no glowing grid over the whole page.

name: Ink and ember
note: Warm black with an ember accent for games and hardware. Works with firelight or forge imagery while keeping body text calm.
avoid: No lava-lamp gradients, no orange glow on every card.

name: Coal and signal
note: A low-glare editor background with one bright signal blue. Made for code, diffs and infrastructure pages.
avoid: No neon green terminal cosplay, no matrix rain.

name: Obsidian and cyan
note: Deep teal-black with a cyan instrument accent. Suits technical products where diagrams and data need to glow quietly.
avoid: No laser-grid backgrounds, no holographic cards.

name: Midnight and sand
nichesNote: Night-time place pages and cinematic game sites
note: A dark olive-black with sand type and a brass accent. For night-time hospitality pages and cinematic game reveals.
avoid: No gold gradients on text, no candle textures.

name: Deep forest
note: Forest black with a living green accent. For worlds, outdoor hardware and environmental software.
avoid: No moss textures, no glowing mushrooms, no fantasy crests.

name: Basalt and amber
note: Basalt surfaces with a machined amber accent. Built for hardware launches and product catalogues that want weight.
avoid: No hazard stripes, no carbon-fibre patterns, no chrome.

name: Navy and signal
note: Navy-black with a soft signal blue. A calm dark mode for software marketing that still reads as technical.
avoid: No purple-blue gradient hero, no glass panels.

name: Slate and rose
note: A dusty neutral page with a rosewood accent. Suits fashion, homeware and editorial commerce where imagery is already colourful.
avoid: No millennial pink, no serif-everything, no soft-focus overlays.

name: Sky and steel
note: Pale sky neutrals with a steel-blue accent. A clean ground for instrumentation, sensors and industrial services.
avoid: No circuit-board decoration, no cyan glow on text.

name: Bone and indigo
note: Bone paper with a deep indigo mark. Strong for editorial technology writing and studios that need authority without a corporate gradient.
avoid: No blue-violet blend, no blueprint grid behind paragraphs.

name: Copper and cream
note: Cream with a copper accent for objects made by hand. Leaves room for leather, clay and metal in the photography.
avoid: No fake patina textures, no sepia treatment of product shots.
